caption: The drawing features a single object resembling a liturgical stole or decorative textile, rendered in a realistic style. The textile is primarily a deep purple color, with the inside lining shown as a light, off-white shade. The edges of the textile are bordered with an ornate trim that combines gold, red, and white hues. The main purple surface is embellished with small, detailed floral embroidery motifs in pastel colors such as green, pink, and yellow. The textile is displayed symmetrically, with both sides of the stole or scarf-like object hanging down vertically from a central neck opening at the top of the composition. The background is a plain, light beige, unadorned surface. The artist's signature, "V. Berge," is present in the lower left corner.
title: Pelerine
